memberdef.name: BODY_PRINT
memberdef.initializer:
= FN_BEGIN POP_VAR("v") DEF_VAR("t") "TYPE LF@t LF@v
" "JUMPIFEQ $print$nil LF@t string@nil
" "JUMPIFEQ $print$array LF@t string@array
" "WRITE LF@v
" "JUMP $print$end
" "LABEL $print$nil
" "WRITE string@()
" "JUMP $print$end
" "LABEL $print$array
" "PUSHS LF@v
" "CALL $toStr
" "POPS LF@t
" "WRITE LF@t
" "LABEL $print$end
" "PUSHS nil@nil
" FN_END

memberdef.name: BODY_SUB_STR
memberdef.initializer:
= FN_BEGIN POP_VAR("e") POP_VAR("s") POP_VAR("v") DEF_VAR("len") DEF_VAR("c") DEF_VAR("r") DEF_VAR("ch") "STRLEN LF@len LF@v
" "LT LF@c LF@s int@0
" "JUMPIFEQ " ERROR_LABEL " LF@c bool@true
" "LT LF@c LF@e int@0
" "JUMPIFEQ " ERROR_LABEL " LF@c bool@true
" "GT LF@c LF@s LF@e
" "JUMPIFEQ " ERROR_LABEL " LF@c bool@true
" "LT LF@c LF@s LF@len
" "JUMPIFEQ " ERROR_LABEL " LF@c bool@false
" "GT LF@c LF@e LF@len
" "JUMPIFEQ " ERROR_LABEL " LF@c bool@true
" "MOVE LF@r string@
" "LABEL $subStr$loop
" "JUMPIFEQ $subStr$done LF@s LF@e
" "GETCHAR LF@ch LF@v LF@s
" "CONCAT LF@r LF@r LF@ch
" "ADD LF@s LF@s int@1
" "JUMP $subStr$loop
" "LABEL $subStr$done
" "PUSHS LF@r
" FN_END

" "LT LF@c LF@i LF@len
" "JUMPIFEQ $ord$end LF@c bool@false

" "LABEL $ord$end

" FN_END

" FN_END

memberdef.name: BODY_LIST_CONCAT
memberdef.initializer:
= FN_BEGIN POP_VAR("b") POP_VAR("a") DEF_VAR("na") DEF_VAR("nb") DEF_VAR("m") DEF_VAR("s") DEF_VAR("c") DEF_VAR("i") DEF_VAR("j") DEF_VAR("d") DEF_VAR("x") DEF_VAR("r") "ARRAYGET LF@na LF@a int@0
" "ARRAYGET LF@nb LF@b int@0
" "ADD LF@m LF@na LF@nb
" "ADD LF@s LF@m int@1
" "NEWARRAY LF@r LF@s
" "ARRAYSET LF@r int@0 LF@m
" "MOVE LF@i int@1
" "LABEL $list$concat$loop_a
" "GT LF@c LF@i LF@na
" "JUMPIFEQ $list$concat$second LF@c bool@true
" "ARRAYGET LF@x LF@a LF@i
" "ARRAYSET LF@r LF@i LF@x
" "ADD LF@i LF@i int@1
" "JUMP $list$concat$loop_a
" "LABEL $list$concat$second
" "MOVE LF@j int@1
" "LABEL $list$concat$loop_b
" "GT LF@c LF@j LF@nb
" "JUMPIFEQ $list$concat$done LF@c bool@true
" "ARRAYGET LF@x LF@b LF@j
" "ADD LF@d LF@na LF@j
" "ARRAYSET LF@r LF@d LF@x
" "ADD LF@j LF@j int@1
" "JUMP $list$concat$loop_b
" "LABEL $list$concat$done
" "PUSHS LF@r
" FN_END
